snippet.title: Raccoons to Riches Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Raccoons to Riches is coming to Steam!

Wishlist today, and try out the free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3778620/Raccoons_to_Riches/

Raccoons to Riches is a Roguelike Deckbuilder all about running a fantasy item shop as an industrious raccoon. Manage your shop and customers over the course of one in-game month to rake in huge profits. Time to Strike it Rich!
